 HPE reports fiscal 2026 fourth quarter results 
 -Q4 results cap a year of record performance driven by strong demand and execution 
 -Raising fiscal 2027 guidance to reflect durability of profitable growth 
 | 
 HOUSTON – November 23, 2026 – HPE (NYSE: HPE) today announced financial results for the fourth quarter ended October 31, 2026. 
 “Fiscal 2026 was a defining year for HPE as we built a new networking industry leader and expanded our role in the AI infrastructure market,” said Antonio Neri, president and CEO of HPE. “We are now a fundamentally different company, with greater earnings power, a stronger competitive position, and a portfolio built to capitalize on the next phase of AI. Our record performance reflects the portfolio we have built to drive durable, profitable growth for our shareholders.” 
 “We achieved an exceptional fiscal 2026 while navigating a highly dynamic market and successfully integrating the largest acquisition in HPE’s history,” said Marie Myers, executive vice president and CFO of HPE. “With disciplined execution, we accelerated returns to shareholders by generating significant margin expansion, record operating profit, and free cash flow more than three times higher than last year. We enter fiscal 2027 in a position of strength, with a significantly higher outlook for revenue, operating profit, and free cash flow.” 
 Fourth Quarter Fiscal 2026 Financial Results 
 • Revenue : $14.5 billion, up 50% from the prior-year period 
 • Gross margins : 
 ◦ GAAP of 38.0%, up 450 basis points from the prior-year period and down 210 basis points sequentially 
 ◦ Non-GAAP (1) of 38.2%, up 180 basis points from the prior-year period and down 220 basis points sequentially 
 • Operating profit margins: 
 ◦ GAAP of 13.4%, up 1,350 basis points from the prior-year period and up 200 basis points sequentially 
 ◦ Non-GAAP (1) of 16.9%, up 470 basis points from the prior-year period and up 70 basis points sequentially 
 • Diluted net earnings per share (“EPS”) : 
 ◦ GAAP of $1.26, up $1.15 from the prior-year period and above our outlook range of $1.12 - $1.22 
 ◦ Non-GAAP (1) of $1.43, up $0.81 from the prior-year period and above our outlook range of $1.20 - $1.30 
 • Cash flow from operations : $2.3 billion, a decrease of $0.1 billion from the prior-year period 
 • Free cash flow (1)(2) : $1.9 billion, flat from the prior-year period 
 • Capital returns to common shareholders: $979 million in the form of dividends and share repurchases 
 Fourth Quarter Fiscal 2026 Segment Results 
 • Networking revenue was $3.1 billion, up 12.3% from the prior-year period, with 22.1% operating profit margin, compared to 23.4% from the prior-year period. 
 ◦ Within Networking, revenue from: 
 ▪ Campus & Branch was $1.5 billion, up 16.7% from the prior-year period. 
 ▪ Data Center Networking was $397 million, up 12.1% from the prior-year period. 
 ▪ Security was $268 million, down 1.8% from the prior-year period. 
 ▪ Routing was $893 million, up 10.1% from the prior-year period. 
 • Cloud & AI revenue was $11.3 billion, up 68.6% from the prior-year period, with 18.4% operating profit margin, compared to 9.3% from the prior-year period. 
 ◦ Within Cloud & AI, revenue from: 
 ▪ Server was $8.8 billion, up 94.7% from the prior-year period. 
 ▪ Storage was $1.5 billion, up 33.8% from the prior-year period. 
 ▪ Financial Services was $0.9 billion, up 1.2% from the prior-year period. 
 • Corporate Investments and Other revenue was $234 million. 
 Dividend and Share Repurchase Authorization 
 The HPE Board of Directors declared a regular cash dividend of $0.17 per share on the company’s common stock, payable on or about January 8, 2027, to stockholders of record as of the close of business on December 9, 2026. 
 HPE’s Board of Directors authorized an additional $5 billion in capacity for repurchases of common stock, bringing the total share repurchase authorization to approximately $7.3 billion as of November 23, 2026. The company plans to continue to return significant free cash flow to shareholders via share repurchases and common dividends, subject to approval by the Board. In FY27, the company is targeting returning at least 75% of its free cash flow to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases. 
 Fiscal 2027 First Quarter Outlook 
 HPE estimates revenue to be in the range of $14.0 billion to $14.6 billion , representing a 51% to 57% growth rate from the prior year. HPE estimates GAAP operating profit growth range to be 195% to 230% and non-GAAP operating profit growth range between 88% to 102% (1)(3) . 
 HPE estimates GAAP diluted net EPS to be in the range of $0.88 to $0.98 and non-GAAP diluted net EPS to be in the range o f $1.30 to $1.40 (1) . Fiscal 2027 first quarter non-GAAP diluted net EPS estimate excludes net after-tax adjustments of approximately $0.42 per diluted share, primarily related to amortization of intangible assets, stock-based compensation expense, and acquisition, disposition and other charges. 
 Fiscal 2027 Full Year Outlook 
 HPE is raising its FY27 revenue growth outlook range to 27% to 35% , representing $59.4 billion to $63.1 billion in revenue. HPE estimates GAAP operating profit growth range to be between 29% to 40% and non-GAAP operating profit growth range to be between 23% to 30% (1)(3) . 
 HPE estimates GAAP diluted net EPS to be in the range of $3.68 to $3.98. The company is raising non-GAAP diluted net EPS estimates to be in the range of $5.05 to $5.35 (1) . Fiscal 2027 non-GAAP diluted net EPS estimate excludes net after-tax adjustments of approximately $1.37 per diluted share, primarily related to amortization of intangible assets, stock-based compensation expense, and acquisition, disposition and other charges. HPE is also raising its free cash flow (1)(2)(4) guidance and now expects free cash flow to be at least $5.5 billion. 
 1 A description of HPE’s use of non-GAAP financial information is provided below under “Use of non-GAAP financial information and key performance metrics.” 
 2 Free cash flow represents cash flow from operations, less net capital expenditures (investments in property, plant & equipment (“PP&E”) and software assets less proceeds from the sale of PP&E), and adjusted for the effect of exchange rate fluctuations on cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash. 
 3 Q1 FY27 non-GAAP operating profit excludes costs of approximately $0.8 billion primarily related to amortization of intangible assets, stock-based compensation expense, and acquisition, disposition and other charges. FY27 non-GAAP operating profit excludes costs of approximately $2.8 billion primarily related to amortization of intangible assets, stock-based compensation expense, and acquisition, disposition and other charges. 
 4 HPE provides certain guidance on a non-GAAP basis. In reliance on the exception provided by Item 10(e)(1)(i)(B) of Regulation S-K, Hewlett Packard Enterprise is unable to provide a reconciliation to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measure without unreasonable efforts, as the Company cannot predict some elements that are included in such directly comparable GAAP financial measure. These elements could have a material impact on the Company’s reported GAAP results for the guidance period. Refer to the discussion of non-GAAP financial measures below for more information. 
 About HPE 
 HPE (NYSE: HPE) is a leader in essential enterprise technology, bringing together the power of AI, cloud, and networking to help organizations achieve more. As pioneers of possibility, our innovation and expertise advance the way people live and work. We empower our customers across industries to optimize operational performance, transform data into foresight, and maximize their impact. Unlock your boldest ambitions with HPE. Discover more at www.hpe.com.

 Use of non-GAAP financial information and key performance metrics 
 To supplement Hewlett Packard Enterprise’s condensed consolidated financial statement information presented on a generally accepted accounting principles (“GAAP”) basis, Hewlett Packard Enterprise provides financial measures, non-GAAP gross profit, non-GAAP gross profit margin, non-GAAP operating profit (non-GAAP earnings from operations), non-GAAP operating profit margin (non-GAAP earnings from operations as a percentage of net revenue), non-GAAP income tax rate, non-GAAP net earnings attributable to HPE and non-GAAP net earnings attributable to common stockholders, non-GAAP diluted net earnings per share attributable to common stockholders, and free cash flow (“FCF”). Hewlett Packard Enterprise also provides forecasts of non-GAAP operating profit growth, non-GAAP diluted net earnings per share, and FCF. Reconciliations of each of these non-GAAP financial measures to their most directly comparable GAAP measures for this quarter and prior periods are included in the tables below or elsewhere in the materials accompanying this news release. In addition an explanation of the ways in which Hewlett Packard Enterprise’s management uses these non-GAAP measures to evaluate its business, the substance behind Hewlett Packard Enterprise’s decision to use these non-GAAP measures, the material limitations associated with the use of these non-GAAP measures, the manner in which Hewlett Packard Enterprise’s management compensates for those limitations, and the substantive reasons why Hewlett Packard Enterprise’s management believes that these non-GAAP measures provide supplemental useful information to investors is included further below. This additional non-GAAP financial information is not meant to be considered in isolation or as a substitute for revenue, gross profit, gross profit margin, operating profit (earnings from operations), operating profit margin (earnings from operations as a percentage of net revenue), net earnings, diluted net earnings (loss) per share (“EPS”), and cash flow from operations prepared in accordance with GAAP.

 On November 23, 2026, HPE announced that its Board of Directors approved an increase of $5 billion in the amount authorized under HPE's share repurchase program. The program does not have an expiration date. 
 Common Stock Dividend

Each quarterly dividend must be declared by the Board of Directors out of legally available sources prior to payment.

 • Cash flow from operations : $2.3 billion, a decrease of $0.1 billion from the prior-year period

 Fourth Quarter Fiscal 2026 Segment Results 
 • Networking revenue was $3.1 billion, up 12.3% from the prior-year period, with 22.1% operating profit margin, compared to 23.4% from the prior-year period. 
 ◦ Within Networking, revenue from: 
 ▪ Campus & Branch was $1.5 billion, up 16.7% from the prior-year period. 
 ▪ Data Center Networking was $397 million, up 12.1% from the prior-year period. 
 ▪ Security was $268 million, down 1.8% from the prior-year period. 
 ▪ Routing was $893 million, up 10.1% from the prior-year period. 
 • Cloud & AI revenue was $11.3 billion, up 68.6% from the prior-year period, with 18.4% operating profit margin, compared to 9.3% from the prior-year period.

 ▪ Server was $8.8 billion, up 94.7% from the prior-year period. 
 ▪ Storage was $1.5 billion, up 33.8% from the prior-year period. 
 ▪ Financial Services was $0.9 billion, up 1.2% from the prior-year period. 
 • Corporate Investments and Other revenue was $234 million. 
 Dividend and Share Repurchase Authorization 
 The HPE Board of Directors declared a regular cash dividend of $0.17 per share on the company’s common stock, payable on or about January 8, 2027, to stockholders of record as of the close of business on December 9, 2026. 
 HPE’s Board of Directors authorized an additional $5 billion in capacity for repurchases of common stock, bringing the total share repurchase authorization to approximately $7.3 billion as of November 23, 2026. The company plans to continue to return significant free cash flow to shareholders via share repurchases and common dividends, subject to approval by the Board. In FY27, the company is targeting returning at least 75% of its free cash flow to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases. 
 Fiscal 2027 First Quarter Outlook 
 HPE estimates revenue to be in the range of $14.0 billion to $14.6 billion , representing a 51% to 57% growth rate from the prior year. HPE estimates GAAP operating profit growth range to be 195% to 230% and non-GAAP operating profit growth range between 88% to 102% (1)(3) . 
 HPE estimates GAAP diluted net EPS to be in the range of $0.88 to $0.98 and non-GAAP diluted net EPS to be in the range o f $1.30 to $1.40 (1) . Fiscal 2027 first quarter non-GAAP diluted net EPS estimate excludes net after-tax adjustments of approximately $0.42 per diluted share, primarily related to amortization of intangible assets, stock-based compensation expense, and acquisition, disposition and other charges. 
 Fiscal 2027 Full Year Outlook 
 HPE is raising its FY27 revenue growth outlook range to 27% to 35% , representing $59.4 billion to $63.1 billion in revenue. HPE estimates GAAP operating profit growth range to be between 29% to 40% and non-GAAP operating profit growth range to be between 23% to 30% (1)(3) . 
 HPE estimates GAAP diluted net EPS to be in the range of $3.68 to $3.98. The company is raising non-GAAP diluted net EPS estimates to be in the range of $5.05 to $5.35 (1) . Fiscal 2027 non-GAAP diluted net EPS estimate excludes net after-tax adjustments of approximately $1.37 per diluted share, primarily related to amortization of intangible assets, stock-based compensation expense, and acquisition, disposition and other charges. HPE is also raising its free cash flow (1)(2)(4) guidance and now expects free cash flow to be at least $5.5 billion.
